comparison.objective: Open the clean-ice source and use a scoop to serve uncontaminated ice; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Lid manipulation, scoop use, source selection, and contamination avoidance versus keyed adjustment, counterholding, tightening, and repeated impact assessment.
comparison.success_condition: At least one clean cube delivered by scoop after lid opening with no contamination; body lacks the complete numeric scorer and no spec version is indexed.
comparison.reason: Tests hygienic tool-mediated transfer, not mechanical commissioning or dynamic stopping performance.
